claim: Mistral Large 2 offers a 128k token context window priced at $2.00 per million input tokens.
source_excerpt: Mistral Large 2 features an advanced 128k context length with pricing set at $2.00/1M input tokens and $6.00/1M output tokens.
notes: Exact context size and numeric pricing match.

claim: Mistral Large 2 is priced at $20 per million input tokens.
source_excerpt: Mistral Large 2 features an advanced 128k context length with pricing set at $2.00/1M input tokens.

claim: Mistral AI was founded in Paris in 2023 by former researchers from DeepMind and Meta.
source_excerpt: Founded in 2023 in Paris, Mistral AI was created by former Google DeepMind and Meta AI researchers.

claim: All Mistral models are completely free for unlimited commercial use.
source_excerpt: Mistral releases open-weights models under Apache 2.0, while enterprise commercial models are billed per token via API.
notes: Direct contradiction regarding commercial model pricing.

claim: Casgevy list price is $2.2 million per treatment in the United States.
source_excerpt: Vertex and CRISPR Therapeutics set the US wholesale acquisition cost for Casgevy at $2.2 million per patient.

claim: Casgevy was approved in all 195 countries worldwide in 2023.
source_excerpt: The US FDA approved Casgevy in December 2023, followed by the UK and European approvals in early 2024.

claim: Casgevy is indicated for patients with sickle cell disease and transfusion-dependent beta thalassemia.
source_excerpt: FDA approved Casgevy for patients aged 12 and older with severe sickle cell disease or transfusion-dependent beta-thalassemia.
notes: Omits the key regulatory age qualification (12 years and older).

claim: Stripe Pay with Crypto charges merchants a 1.5% transaction fee.
source_excerpt: Crypto transactions incur a 1.5% fee on the total transaction amount, with automatic conversion to fiat currency.

claim: Stripe charges no transaction fees on stablecoin payments.
source_excerpt: Crypto transactions incur a 1.5% fee on the total transaction amount, with automatic conversion to fiat currency.

claim: Stripe acquired stablecoin startup Bridge for approximately $1.1 billion.
source_excerpt: Stripe completed the acquisition of stablecoin payment infrastructure provider Bridge in an agreement valued at $1.1B.

claim: Stripe acquired Bridge for $11 billion.
source_excerpt: Stripe completed the acquisition of stablecoin payment infrastructure provider Bridge in an agreement valued at $1.1B.

claim: Claude 3.5 Sonnet offers a 200,000 token context window and pricing of $3 per million input tokens.
source_excerpt: Claude 3.5 Sonnet operates with a 200k context window, priced at $3.00 per million input tokens and $15.00 per million output tokens.

claim: Claude 3.5 Sonnet includes Computer Use capabilities allowing direct desktop interaction.
source_excerpt: Anthropic introduced an upgraded Claude 3.5 Sonnet featuring Computer Use in public beta, allowing developers to direct Claude to interact with computer screens.
notes: Omits that Computer Use is currently in 'public beta' rather than general availability.

claim: Pinecone Serverless charges solely for storage with zero fees for reads or writes.
source_excerpt: Pinecone Serverless decouples reads, writes, and storage, billing per read unit (RU), write unit (WU), and GB of vector data.

claim: Pinecone Serverless separates read, write, and storage billing tiers.
source_excerpt: Pinecone Serverless decouples reads, writes, and storage, billing per read unit (RU), write unit (WU), and GB of vector data.

claim: Databricks Unity Catalog provides centralized governance across tables, files, and AI models.
source_excerpt: Unity Catalog acts as a unified governance solution for data and AI assets across multiple clouds, governing tables, volumes, and registered models.

claim: Databricks Unity Catalog is restricted exclusively to the Microsoft Azure platform.
source_excerpt: Unity Catalog delivers cross-cloud governance interoperating across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.

claim: OpenAI o1 reasoning model costs $15 per million input tokens.
source_excerpt: The full OpenAI o1 model is available via the API at $15.00 per million input tokens and $60.00 per million output tokens.

claim: OpenAI o1 solves 100% of PhD-level physics exam questions without error.
source_excerpt: On difficult competitive benchmarks, OpenAI o1 performs comparably to PhD students in physics and chemistry, achieving an 83% accuracy rate on GPQA Diamond.
notes: Exaggerates 83% benchmark performance to 100% flawless accuracy.

claim: Starlink Direct to Cell delivers high-speed gigabit fiber internet to ordinary smartphones.
source_excerpt: Starlink Direct to Cell provides basic text messaging connectivity to unmodified LTE phones, expanding to voice and low-bandwidth IoT data.
notes: Misrepresents low-bandwidth text messaging as gigabit fiber speed.

claim: Starlink Direct to Cell partners with mobile network operators including T-Mobile in the US.
source_excerpt: SpaceX partnered with T-Mobile in the United States and international carriers to enable Direct to Cell text messaging service.

claim: Cloudflare Workers AI bills inference based on Neurons.
source_excerpt: Workers AI calculates usage using Neurons, a standardized unit measuring compute across diverse model architectures.

claim: Figma Dev Mode is included for free in all starter plans forever.
source_excerpt: Following the open beta period, Figma introduced paid Dev Mode seats priced at $25 per seat/month on Organization plans.

claim: Figma Dev Mode costs $25 per seat/month on Organization plans.
source_excerpt: Following the open beta period, Figma introduced paid Dev Mode seats priced at $25 per seat/month on Organization plans.

claim: Anthropic was acquired by Amazon for $40 billion.
source_excerpt: Amazon completed a minority investment of $4 billion into Anthropic, maintaining Anthropic as an independent corporation.
notes: Wrong amount ($4B vs $40B) and wrong transaction type (minority investment vs full acquisition).

claim: Codestral supports code completion across 80+ programming languages.
source_excerpt: Trained on over 80 programming languages, Codestral provides high-speed fill-in-the-middle code generation.

claim: Codestral only supports Python and JavaScript.
source_excerpt: Trained on over 80 programming languages, Codestral provides high-speed fill-in-the-middle code generation.
notes: Held-out test: falsely restricts 80+ languages to 2.

claim: Casgevy was developed as a collaboration between Vertex Pharmaceuticals and CRISPR Therapeutics.
source_excerpt: Casgevy was co-developed by Vertex Pharmaceuticals and CRISPR Therapeutics under a global joint development and commercialization pact.

claim: Vertex Pharmaceuticals developed Casgevy without any industry partners.
source_excerpt: Casgevy was co-developed by Vertex Pharmaceuticals and CRISPR Therapeutics under a global joint development and commercialization pact.
notes: Held-out test: directly contradicts joint collaboration.

claim: Stripe supports USDC stablecoin payouts on Solana, Ethereum, and Polygon.
source_excerpt: Stripe's Pay with Crypto accepts USDC transactions natively settled across Solana, Ethereum, and Polygon blockchains.
notes: Held-out test: exact blockchain list match.

claim: Stripe supports stablecoin payouts exclusively on Bitcoin.
source_excerpt: Stripe's Pay with Crypto accepts USDC transactions natively settled across Solana, Ethereum, and Polygon blockchains.

claim: OpenAI o1 mini is optimized for coding, STEM, and math reasoning tasks at an 80% lower cost than o1.
source_excerpt: o1-mini delivers cost-efficient reasoning tailored to math and coding benchmarks, priced at $3.00/1M input and $12.00/1M output, approximately 80% cheaper than full o1.
notes: Held-out test: exact target domain and discount rate.

claim: o1-mini outperforms full o1 across all humanities and creative writing benchmarks.
source_excerpt: While o1-mini excels at STEM reasoning, OpenAI notes that full o1 retains broader factual knowledge and superior creative writing proficiency.
notes: Held-out test: complete inversion of documented capabilities.

claim: Figma Enterprise subscription includes private workspace provisioning and advanced security controls.
source_excerpt: Figma Enterprise tier offers dedicated workspaces, SCIM provisioning, centralized audit logs, and custom session timeouts.
notes: Held-out test: matches enterprise feature specifications.

claim: Starlink has launched over 6,000 low-Earth orbit satellites to date.
source_excerpt: SpaceX has deployed more than 6,000 Starlink satellites into low Earth orbit to support its broadband constellation.
notes: Held-out test: exact count and orbit match.
